plugins.name: handoff-generator
plugins.description: Interactive, bidirectional Chat↔Code generator for a comprehensive project handoff — progress, features, decisions, changelog, next actions, and a near-verbatim session log.

plugins.name: changelog-tracker
plugins.description: Documents every substantive commit into per-commit changelog files plus a rolling CHANGELOG index.

plugins.name: model-strategy
plugins.description: Creates and maintains docs/MODEL-STRATEGY.md — which Claude model to use for which work, tailored via interview.

plugins.name: branch-naming
plugins.description: Suggests and optionally creates a git branch name following the project's convention.

plugins.name: repo-setup
plugins.description: Scaffolds a project's context stack — the tiered docs folders that let an agent be briefed on a project — and registers the routing table in CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: decisions-logger
plugins.description: Mines a project for the decisions that were actually made and writes each as a numbered ADR with its evidence — asking when the "why" was never written down, and never inventing one.

plugins.name: skill-scaffold
plugins.description: Generates a new skill in this library's conventions — PRD, SKILL.md skeleton, plugin.json, marketplace entry, README row and website entry — from a short interview.

plugins.name: design-setup
plugins.description: Scaffolds a project's design context stack — briefs, research, explorations, decisions, specs, system — and registers the routing table in CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: design-brief
plugins.description: Interviews you into a short, structured design brief — problem, who feels it, jobs to be done, constraints, success criteria and non-goals — and marks what wasn't stated rather than inventing it.

plugins.name: design-decisions
plugins.description: Records a design fork as a numbered, append-only ADR — options, what was chosen, what was given up, and what would make us revisit — and never invents a rationale.
